_meta.description: Canned AI extraction response for the Hollow Oak June 19, 2026 deal email. Served by /api/extract-deal when the pasted prose mentions 'Hollow Oak'. The fixture in db/seed.ts deliberately has no deal record — Mariana captures it live in the Loom by pasting the source_prose below into /shows/show_hollow_oak_jun/deal/capture.
_meta.demo_use: Loom: paste the source_prose into the capture flow, click Extract, this response renders after a 1500ms loading state.

source_prose:
Hi Mariana,

Confirming Hollow Oak for 6/19.

Deal is $4,000 vs 75% of net after expenses. Expenses capped at $2,000, marketing recoup of $750 against gross. Hospitality cap $400. Performance bonuses per the deal memo (see email thread).

Best,
Sarah

ambiguities.prose_span: Expenses capped at $2,000, marketing recoup of $750 against gross
ambiguities.description: The $750 marketing recoup could be positioned off-gross (in addition to the $2,000 expense cap) or treated as inside the $2,000 cap. The two readings produce different settlement totals at ~$560 apart.

candidate_readings.label: Off gross (in addition to cap)
candidate_readings.interpretation: The $750 is deducted from gross BEFORE fees and expenses. The $2,000 cap applies separately to other operational expenses.
candidate_readings.estimated_impact: Reduces artist payout. At ~$18k gross, this reading yields roughly $560 less to the artist than the alternative.

candidate_readings.label: Inside cap
candidate_readings.interpretation: The $750 marketing recoup counts as part of the $2,000 expense cap. The venue absorbs any operational+marketing spend above $2,000.
candidate_readings.estimated_impact: Higher artist payout by roughly $560 at typical show gross.

ambiguities.suggested_clarification: Quick clarification on the deal: is the $750 marketing recoup inside the $2,000 expense cap, or in addition to it? Want to lock this in before we settle.

ambiguities.prose_span: Performance bonuses per the deal memo (see email thread)
ambiguities.description: The deal email references performance bonuses but doesn't specify them inline. We need the bonus structure (gross threshold? attendance threshold? sellout?) before settlement, otherwise the engine can't evaluate them.

candidate_readings.label: No bonuses (assume omission)
candidate_readings.interpretation: Treat the reference as boilerplate; no structured bonuses apply to this show.
candidate_readings.estimated_impact: Conservative. Risks missing a bonus the agent expects to fire.

candidate_readings.label: Bonuses exist — ask for spec
candidate_readings.interpretation: Reply asking Sarah to forward the deal memo or paste the bonus structure inline so we can capture it.
candidate_readings.estimated_impact: Unknown until specified. Could be material.

ambiguities.suggested_clarification: Quick clarification: can you forward the deal memo with the performance bonus structure? Want to make sure we have those captured before settlement.

prose_spans.bonuses: Performance bonuses per the deal memo (see email thread)
